summary: The pixel art style is consistent throughout the reel with clear character designs. However, several shots suffer from missing characters, text mismatch, and poor framing.

clean: Character poses and mate holding match basic pixel style rules.
unclean: Shot 8: Figure cut off at edge of screen.
Shot 9: Yaguarete action is represented by a static small sprite rather than an attack.
Shot 12: Scene is empty of characters during the gift revelation.
Shot 14: Sentence spoken does not match the on-screen text.

clean: Pixel fonts and color palettes fit the pixel8 aesthetic.
unclean: Shot 14: On-screen text graphics display text from an earlier shot.

issues.problem: Moon character is sliced at the right edge.
issues.fix: Keep character sprites within canvas margins.

issues.problem: Jaguar attack visual lacks motion or clear interaction.
issues.fix: Add animated attack frame or larger sprite interaction.

issues.problem: Frame shows only background trees without subject.
issues.fix: Include character or explicit gift visual centrally.

issues.problem: Text overlays show repeated lines from previous shot.
issues.fix: Sync text engine to spoken line array.

learnings.rule: Avoid text overlay desynchronization with audio transcript.
Keep main figures centered away from vertical edge boundaries.
